newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Henry Walker says in line with budget.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Henry Walker says in line with budget.

text.p: Henry Walker Group Ltd said on Tuesday that its results in the two months to the end of August were in line with budget.
Henry Walker chairman Neville Walker told the annual general meeting that it had set a target of 10 percent growth in revenue and earnings for the current year ending June 30, 1997.
"With only two months' trading results to hand, it is still too early to reliably predict the company's likely performance against these targets," Walker said.
"Results to the end of August are consistent with budget."
He said the company would consolidate its mining and civil engineering contracting business in the current year, with a plan to secure a medium-to-long term contract in South America and Indonesia.
The company achieved a 14 percent rise in 1995/96 net profit to A$17.7 million. Sales rose to A$433.6 million from A$293.3 million. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
